Queue

Keep open work, priorities, and account search in one list.

Open work

Keep the team’s open cases in view. Search accounts, filter priorities, and move directly into an investigation.

Priorities

Each case shows why it is in the queue. The band is a sort for the desk, not a fraud score and not a guilt label.

Account search

Find a synthetic account and open its file. The demo queue starts at acct_demo. Nothing here is a customer record.

Case file

Read each signal next to the record that produced it.

Read the signal

Each rule shows its threshold next to the value that fired it. The finding stays attached to the source record.

Follow the evidence

Transactions and source records sit in the same file. A claim that cannot point at evidence does not get presented as fact.

Write the decision

Notes, escalation, and resolve all ask for a rationale. Resolve on this desk means no adverse action. The model does not decide.

Graph

Recorded links give context. They do not establish identity.

Observed links

Accounts, transactions, merchants, devices, and locations appear only where the synthetic data recorded a link.

Replay a rule

The knockout desk replays the same rules under a hypothetical edit. The ledger does not change. A cleared replay is not proof the activity was legitimate.

A person decides

The assistant can point at gaps in the file. It cannot freeze an account, move money, or close the case. Role permissions decide who can write.

Frequently Asked Questions

No. Resolve on this desk is recorded as no adverse action. The workspace does not freeze accounts, move money, or send a decision to a bank. The file keeps the rationale and the audit trail. That is the whole action.

A versioned rule compares a threshold with a value in the synthetic ledger. The case file shows both, next to the source record. If a claim cannot point at an evidence id, the desk does not treat it as established.

No. Northwind is a synthetic tenant. Accounts, transactions, and relationships were generated for the demo. Demo access is included. There is no production bank behind the queue.

An investigator can read and draft. A senior investigator can escalate and resolve. A viewer can read and cannot write. Significant decisions require a rationale and are recorded with the person who made them.

It shows links the synthetic data recorded. A shared device or a repeated merchant is context, not an identity finding. Triage bands are not fraud probabilities. The graph does not decide the case.
